pendingForNextSession.description: True while a session is open and the stored configuration was changed after it started: the change applies to the next session.

SttConfig.description: The STT configuration (C3 §2.5 op 90). It carries `credentialSet` and `credentialKind` only: no credential, reference target, ciphertext or nonce exists in this shape.

ref.description: REFERENCE only: a pointer `<store>:<pointer>`, e.g. `omlx-settings:auth.api_key`. Never key material. Write-only.

value.description: SECRET only: the secret. Write-only: stored encrypted, never returned, logged or audited, never pre-filled.

SttCredentialWrite.description: Write-only credential of `updateSttConfig`: a reference (`ref`), a secret to store encrypted (`value`), or CLEAR. No answer echoes it.

revision.description: The `revision` of the configuration this update was made from (optimistic lock).

backend.description: One of omlx-server, cpu-local; anything else: BACKEND_UNKNOWN.

endpoint.description: Loopback only: scheme `http`, host `127.0.0.1` or `localhost`, optional port and path, and no `?`, `#`, backslash, white space or control character; anything else: ENDPOINT_NOT_LOOPBACK.

model.description: A model IDENTIFIER, never a file name or a path: 1 to 128 of `A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -`, starting with a letter or a digit, without `..` and without a trailing `.bin`. Anything else: 422 INVALID_INPUT.

SttConfigUpdateRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/transcription/config` (C3 §2.5 op 91): `revision` plus the members to change.

enabled.description: False: no transcriber work in the next session; the package records `transcript.state = DISABLED`.

backend.description: `omlx-server` (development on this Mac) or `cpu-local` (whisper.cpp on the Core).

endpoint.description: The loopback endpoint of the server backend (OD-13). Absent when none is stored.

model.description: Model id (server backend) or model reference (`cpu-local`). Never a secret.

credentialSet.description: True when a credential is configured. The credential itself is never returned.

credentialKind.description: How the credential is held; absent when none is set. A flag, never a value.

revision.description: Optimistic revision: send it back in `updateSttConfig`.

updatedBy.description: The operator of the last change; absent for the seeded configuration.

updatedAt.description: When the configuration last changed, epoch milliseconds.

pendingForNextSession.description: True while a session is open and the stored configuration was changed after it started: the change applies to the next session.

appliesFrom.description: `NEXT_SESSION` while a session is open (it keeps the snapshot of its start); `NOW` when idle.

SttConfigUpdateResult.description: The stored configuration after `updateSttConfig`, with when it takes effect. Never the credential.

reachable.description: The backend answered. `false` is a 200 result, not an HTTP error.

modelAvailable.description: The configured model is available on the backend.

detailCode.description: A SCREAMING_SNAKE result code, e.g. OK, UNREACHABLE, MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE.

SttConnectionTest.description: The result of `testSttConnection` (C3 §2.5 op 92). No audio is sent and no speed figure is reported (D230).

address.description: One address the operator typed, e.g. `192.168.10.20`: one dotted IPv4 literal, four decimal parts from 0 to 255 without a leading zero. Never a host name, a port, a prefix, a URL or an IPv6 literal. With it the search also sends ONE unicast probe to this address, when the Core lets the address pass. Web console only. Absent: the search probes the fixed multicast group and nothing else.

CaptureDiscoveryStartRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/capture/discovery` (C3 §2.6 op 93; task 4 AM-3). Optional, and `{}` is the search without a typed address. No host, port, URL, path, subnet, interface, timeout or filter member exists.

searchId.description: `DSC-NNNNNN`. It is in no path: operation 94 answers the caller's own search only.

scope.description: A search of operation 93 looks for cameras on the network.

trigger.description: MANUAL: operation 93. PRECHECK: the one search of a pre-check run with an unreachable camera. AUTO: the Core's own SMART ATTACH segment sweep, behind `DEMS_CAMERA_AUTOATTACH` (decision D62, 2026-11-05): its targets are the Core's ARP observations and no caller supplies one.

state.description: RUNNING until the window closes; then COMPLETE, or FAILED when the search could not run.

expiresAt.description: When the candidate list is discarded: `completesAt` + the result life.

newCount.description: Answers that match no registered capture device. 0 while RUNNING.

registeredCount.description: Answers that match a registered capture device. 0 while RUNNING.

interfaceCount.description: Network interfaces probed: a count, never a name or an address.

failureReason.description: Why a FAILED search could not run, as a code (e.g. `NO_ELIGIBLE_INTERFACE`, `SOCKET_ERROR`); null otherwise.

created.description: True for a new search (202). False when the caller's own search is still RUNNING and no second probe was sent (200).

CaptureDiscoverySearch.description: One camera search (C3 §2.6). Counts and codes only: no address, no device text.

candidateId.description: Minted by the Core at random per search; meaningful only inside the owner session.

adapter.description: The adapter kind: `ONVIF_RTSP`, or `FAKE` for a fixture source on loopback.

sourceClass.description: Derived by the Core from `adapter`; never set by a client.

host.description: The address the answer came from: an IP literal, never a URL, never `user:password@`.

endpointRef.description: The announced endpoint reference. Untrusted device text.

vendor.description: Announced. Untrusted device text: draw it as text only.

model.description: Announced. Untrusted device text: draw it as text only.

name.description: Announced. Untrusted device text: draw it as text only.

status.description: REGISTERED when it matches a capture device: by its endpoint reference, else by its whole address.

deviceId.description: The registered capture device when `status` is REGISTERED; null otherwise.

testable.description: False when no announced service address qualifies, or its host is not `host`: such a candidate is listed and can never be tested.

connectionTarget.description: What the Core connects to for a connection test of this candidate, exactly as it uses it: scheme, host, port (always written) and path. Its host is `host`; the scheme, the port and the path are what the device announced: untrusted, draw it as text only, never as a link. Absent for a candidate that is not testable, and in Simulated capture (no connection is made there).

conflict.description: Two answers share one endpoint reference from different addresses, or one address announced two references: every such row is listed and none is testable.

addressChanged.description: REGISTERED by endpoint reference while the answering address differs from the stored one.

authenticated.description: Whether a credential was supplied: a fact, never a value.

reason.description: Present only for an AUTHENTICATION_FAILED test in which the credential was NOT sent (see `CaptureConnectionTestReason`).

lastTest.description: The last connection test of this candidate in this search; null before the first.

adoptable.description: `status` NEW and a REACHABLE `lastTest` that is still valid.

CaptureCandidate.description: One candidate of a camera search (C3 §2.6). Not a capture device: it registers nothing and is in no slice. Carries no credential.

search.description: Null when the caller's session has no live search: never started, expired, or replaced.

candidates.description: Empty while RUNNING, complete once COMPLETE. Registered matches first, then arrival order; the list never shrinks or reorders during its life.

truncated.description: True when more than 64 devices answered: a warning, not a note.

CaptureDiscoveryState.description: The camera search of the calling operator session (C3 §2.6). Another session, whatever its role, reads its own.

credential.description: The camera credential to test with. Write-only: never stored, returned, logged or audited.

CaptureConnectionTestRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/capture/discovery/candidates/{id}/test` (C3 §2.6 op 95). No address, host, port, URL, path or profile member exists.

authenticated.description: Whether a credential was supplied: a fact, never a value.

usableProfileCount.description: Usable media profiles the test read: profiles whose stream is H.264 or HEVC, as the Core judged it. A count: no profile name and no codec text.

failedAttemptsRemaining.description: Refused credentials this host may still see before the lock-out guard closes.

reason.description: Present only for an AUTHENTICATION_FAILED test in which the credential was NOT sent (see `CaptureConnectionTestReason`).

CaptureConnectionTest.description: The outcome of one connection test (C3 §2.6 op 95). No device error text, no URL, no credential member.

credential.description: The camera credential to store with the new device. Write-only: never returned, logged or audited.

deviceId.description: The new capture device, e.g. `CAM-05`: the next free number, minted by the Core.

kind.description: The `capture_devices.kind` value set: CAMERA, MIC, POE.

host.description: Host or address only; never a credential URL (C-N8).

online.description: On a Core in its own capture this is the registry flag of the device (`capture_devices.enabled`), NOT a reachability reading: it is true from the moment the device is registered and changes only when a pre-check, a session start or a microphone re-scan has actually asked the source (false: it did not answer; true again: it answered). Outside those moments the Core has not checked the source, so `true` means "registered and not found unreachable at the last check" - never "reachable now": a client at rest says "Not checked", not "Online" or "Ready" (finding JW-23). In Simulated mode it is the demonstration model's value.

streamState.description: Null for a device with no stream (a mic, the PoE switch). Like `online`, not a reading at rest on a Core in its own capture (finding JW-23).

capabilities.description: Capability codes the adapters reported; an open set.

adapter.description: The adapter kind behind the device (C3 §2.6 "Device shapes"): `ONVIF_RTSP`, `USB_AUDIO`, `SNMP_POE`, `FAKE` or `LOCAL_DEVICE`. Present on a device that operation 96 registered.

sourceClass.description: Derived by the Core from `adapter`: `DEVELOPMENT` exactly for `FAKE` and `LOCAL_DEVICE`. Never set by a client.

sourceOpen.description: True while the Core holds this source open (C3 §2.6, erratum PE-128-38; SEC35-44 (4)): the "is on" fact of a `LOCAL_DEVICE` - the short open of a pre-check included. A runtime fact, never stored: absent when the source is not open, after a restart until it opens, and always in simulated capture.

profiles.description: The stream profiles the Core holds stored for this camera (`capture_devices.profiles`), in the stored order, each code once. A production camera is assigned to a track with ONE of them: the `code` is sent as `profile` of a camera line of operation 78 (operation 79 carries no profile). An EMPTY list: the Core holds no profile for this camera - it cannot be assigned, and no default stands in (C36). Present on every registered camera (one that operation 96 added); absent on every other entry (a microphone, the PoE switch, a built-in device). No credential, no address, no URL, no text of the camera.

code.description: The profile code (`HEVC_1080P`, `H264_720P30`): upper-case letters, digits and underscores, 1 to 64 characters. The value a camera line of operation 78 names as `profile`.

codec.description: The codec the code states: a closed set. Null when the code is no stream statement. Never a default.

resolution.description: The picture the code states: `<height>p` for a 16:9 picture, else `<width>x<height>`. Null when the code is no stream statement. Never a default.

fps.description: The whole-number rate the code states, 1 to 240; null when it states none (an HEVC stream states no rate). Never a default.

items.description: One stored stream profile of a camera: its code and what the code states of the stream.

retiredAt.description: When the device was retired (operation 111, `capture_devices.retired_at`). PRESENT ONLY ON A RETIRED DEVICE, always together with `retiredBy`: its stored credential is destroyed, it is never assigned again, and a client lists it with a Retired state and leaves it out of every selector and assignment list. Absent: the device is in service. A retired device stays in the registry for good (its id is never reused).

retiredBy.description: The operator who retired the device (`OPR-NNN`). Present exactly when `retiredAt` is.

device.description: One capture device (`dbc-3 §B.2`); carries no credential (RK-12).

credentialSet.description: Whether a credential was stored with the device: a fact, never a value.

CaptureCandidateAdoption.description: The capture device an adoption registered (C3 §2.6 op 96).

inputId.description: The mic input (`MIC-NN`) this device stands behind in the selector; null when it is assigned to none.

adapter.description: The adapter kind of the microphone. ABSENT on a Core in SIMULATED capture, which states no adapter and no source class on any operation (decision D196, gate 70 finding G70-01).

sourceClass.description: Derived by the Core from `adapter`; absent exactly when `adapter` is.

errorCode.description: The named cause when a local input cannot be opened; null otherwise.

unregisteredCount.description: Local inputs that are no registered microphone: a count only.

CaptureInputScan.description: The local microphone inputs as a re-read found them (C3 §2.6 op 97). It registers nothing.

cardId.description: The card id in the kernel's own form. A request of operation 99 names a card by it.

deviceIndex.description: The capture device of the card: 0 to 31.

usbId.description: Vendor and product id of a USB card, `vvvv:pppp` in lower-case hexadecimal; null for a card that is not USB.

usbSerial.description: The serial number a USB card states: letters, digits and `: . _ -`, 1 to 64 characters. Null when the card states none, or one outside this form. Untrusted device text: it tells two cards of one model apart; draw it as text only. Absent in an answer of the in-app simulator.

usbPort.description: The port a USB card sits on, in the kernel's own topological form (e.g. `0000:00:14.0-2.1`); null for a card that is not USB. Read by the Core from the kernel, never from the device. Informational: it is no longer compared. Absent in an answer of the in-app simulator.

product.description: The product name the card announced. Untrusted device text: printable ASCII only, 1 to 64 characters; a name that fails the rule is replaced by a fixed word before it is answered. Draw it as text only.

channelCount.description: The native channel count of the card: its inputs are numbered 1 to this value.

sampleBits.description: The sample sizes the card offers, in bits. A closed set; never a format name of the device.

deviceId.description: The registered microphone behind this input, e.g. `MIC-03`.

registered.description: The inputs of this card that are registered microphones, by input number. An input that is not listed is not registered.

boundTo.description: The microphone that holds this sound card, by the identity rule (its serial number where it states one, else its USB id; never its port). A card with a microphone is not offered for a new binding: registering another input of it is refused `AUDIO_CARD_ALREADY_BOUND` unless the request releases the holder. Null: no microphone holds the card. With null, `registered` is empty; a holder that `registered` does not name was registered under another kernel card id and is still this physical card.

CaptureAudioCard.description: One sound card of the Core's host as a listing found it (task 4, operation 98). It registers nothing and is in no slice.

cards.description: One entry per capture device of a sound card. Empty when the host has none.

truncated.description: True when the host has more than 32 entries: a warning, not a note.

CaptureAudioCardSearch.description: The sound cards of the Core's host as one listing found them (task 4, operation 98). Not stored.

cardId.description: A card of the Core's own listing, by its card id.

deviceIndex.description: The capture device of that card.

inputNumber.description: The input to register: 1 to the channel count of the card.

release.description: True: register this input and release the microphone that holds the same sound card (decision D10 (1)). False or absent (the default is false): a card another microphone holds is refused.

CaptureAudioInputRegisterRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/capture/audio-cards/inputs` (task 4, operation 99). No product name, USB id, channel count, sample size, path or address member exists.

deviceId.description: The microphone behind the input, e.g. `MIC-03`: the next free number for a new one, minted by the Core.

change.description: REGISTERED: a new microphone. REENABLED: the input already had one; no second device was made. CARD_CHANGED: the stored input now has another card behind it (another USB id, or a serial number that differs, appears or disappears). A port move is not a change.

channelCount.description: The native channel count the Core read from its own listing.

releasedDeviceId.description: The microphone this registration released (`release: true` and the card was held by another microphone); null otherwise.

CaptureAudioInputRegistration.description: What a registration of a sound-card input did (task 4, operation 99). No device text.

deviceId.description: The registered camera whose stored address is replaced, e.g. `CAM-01`.

candidateId.description: The candidate of the caller's own live search that is this camera by its endpoint reference (`status: REGISTERED`, `addressChanged: true`).

address.description: The address the operator saw and confirmed: one dotted IPv4 literal, or that and `:port`. It must equal the address the candidate holds now; the Core takes the address from its own search state, never from here.

CaptureDeviceAddressConfirmRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/capture/devices/address/confirm` (task 4, operation 100): the confirmation of an operator. No member carries a credential.

deviceId.description: The registered camera.

kind.description: The `capture_devices.kind` value set: CAMERA, MIC, POE.

host.description: Host or address only; never a credential URL (C-N8).

online.description: On a Core in its own capture this is the registry flag of the device (`capture_devices.enabled`), NOT a reachability reading: it is true from the moment the device is registered and changes only when a pre-check, a session start or a microphone re-scan has actually asked the source (false: it did not answer; true again: it answered). Outside those moments the Core has not checked the source, so `true` means "registered and not found unreachable at the last check" - never "reachable now": a client at rest says "Not checked", not "Online" or "Ready" (finding JW-23). In Simulated mode it is the demonstration model's value.

streamState.description: Null for a device with no stream (a mic, the PoE switch). Like `online`, not a reading at rest on a Core in its own capture (finding JW-23).

capabilities.description: Capability codes the adapters reported; an open set.

adapter.description: The adapter kind behind the device (C3 §2.6 "Device shapes"): `ONVIF_RTSP`, `USB_AUDIO`, `SNMP_POE`, `FAKE` or `LOCAL_DEVICE`. Present on a device that operation 96 registered.

sourceClass.description: Derived by the Core from `adapter`: `DEVELOPMENT` exactly for `FAKE` and `LOCAL_DEVICE`. Never set by a client.

sourceOpen.description: True while the Core holds this source open (C3 §2.6, erratum PE-128-38; SEC35-44 (4)): the "is on" fact of a `LOCAL_DEVICE` - the short open of a pre-check included. A runtime fact, never stored: absent when the source is not open, after a restart until it opens, and always in simulated capture.

profiles.description: The stream profiles the Core holds stored for this camera (`capture_devices.profiles`), in the stored order, each code once. A production camera is assigned to a track with ONE of them: the `code` is sent as `profile` of a camera line of operation 78 (operation 79 carries no profile). An EMPTY list: the Core holds no profile for this camera - it cannot be assigned, and no default stands in (C36). Present on every registered camera (one that operation 96 added); absent on every other entry (a microphone, the PoE switch, a built-in device). No credential, no address, no URL, no text of the camera.

code.description: The profile code (`HEVC_1080P`, `H264_720P30`): upper-case letters, digits and underscores, 1 to 64 characters. The value a camera line of operation 78 names as `profile`.

codec.description: The codec the code states: a closed set. Null when the code is no stream statement. Never a default.

resolution.description: The picture the code states: `<height>p` for a 16:9 picture, else `<width>x<height>`. Null when the code is no stream statement. Never a default.

fps.description: The whole-number rate the code states, 1 to 240; null when it states none (an HEVC stream states no rate). Never a default.

items.description: One stored stream profile of a camera: its code and what the code states of the stream.

retiredAt.description: When the device was retired (operation 111, `capture_devices.retired_at`). PRESENT ONLY ON A RETIRED DEVICE, always together with `retiredBy`: its stored credential is destroyed, it is never assigned again, and a client lists it with a Retired state and leaves it out of every selector and assignment list. Absent: the device is in service. A retired device stays in the registry for good (its id is never reused).

retiredBy.description: The operator who retired the device (`OPR-NNN`). Present exactly when `retiredAt` is.

device.description: One capture device (`dbc-3 §B.2`); carries no credential (RK-12).

CaptureDeviceAddressConfirmation.description: The registered camera after an operator confirmed its new address (task 4, operation 100). The stored credential stays with the device and is never returned.

configured.description: True when both the camera interface and the camera subnet are set. False: the factory address scan and the camera address change answer `COMMISSIONING_NOT_CONFIGURED`; the camera search, a typed address and the connection of a camera do not need them.

interfaceName.description: The network interface the cameras are on, as the operator chose it. Null: not chosen. The Core never chooses one.

cameraSubnet.description: The camera subnet as `a.b.c.d/n`, prefix length 16 to 30. Null: not chosen.

factoryAddresses.description: The factory addresses a scan asks: at most 32 private IPv4 host addresses. A camera at another address is found only by a typed address.

aliasHost.description: The host part (2 to 254) of the temporary address the Core takes in a factory /24.

aliasMinutes.description: The lifetime of a temporary address in minutes (5 to 480): the kernel removes the address when it ends.

cameraIpStart.description: The host part (2 to 250) of the first address a set-network job offers a camera in the camera subnet.

onvifPorts.description: The ports a stored camera's ONVIF device service may be dialled on: 1 to 8 whole numbers 1 to 65535, no port twice, in the order written; [80] for a configuration nobody has written yet. A camera stored without a port is dialled on 80, which must then be listed.

revision.description: Optimistic revision: send it back in `updateCaptureNetworkConfig`. 1 for a configuration nobody has written yet.

updatedAt.description: When the configuration was last written; null when nobody has written it yet.

updatedBy.description: Who wrote it last; null when nobody has.

CaptureNetworkConfig.description: The camera network configuration of the Core (task 4, operations 101 and 102; schema set B). One per Core. It holds no credential.

revision.description: The `revision` of the configuration this update was made from (optimistic lock).

interfaceName.description: The camera interface; null clears the choice.

cameraSubnet.description: The camera subnet as `a.b.c.d/n`; null clears the choice.

onvifPorts.description: The whole list of allowed ONVIF ports, replacing the stored one: 1 to 8 ports 1 to 65535, no port twice, in order.

CaptureNetworkConfigUpdateRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/capture/network/config` (task 4, operation 102). No member carries a credential, a gateway or a DHCP mode; the only ports are the allowed ONVIF port list.

address.description: The temporary address, without its prefix length (always /24).

reason.description: What it was added for.

expiresAt.description: When the kernel removes the address by itself.

removeError.description: The code of a removal that failed (the address is then still in place); null otherwise. A code, never the helper's text.

HostAlias.description: The temporary host address in place (task 4, schema set B). One at a time.

alias.description: The temporary address in place; null when there is none.

HostAliasState.description: The alias state of the Core host (task 4, operations 104 and 105).

address.description: ONE address the operator typed, asked beside the stored list. A camera outside the list is found only this way.

CameraFactoryScanRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/capture/network/scan` (task 4, operation 103). No list, range, subnet, port, interface or timeout can be sent.

address.description: The address that answered: one of the addresses the scan asked.

mac.description: The hardware address from the host's neighbour table; null when the table holds none.

onvifReachable.description: Whether the unauthenticated ONVIF check was answered. False: the camera may need activation in its own web page first.

endpointCount.description: How many distinct devices answered from this address, when the scan counted them; null when it could not count. Null is NOT one.

deviceCount.description: What the Core knows of the number of devices at this address. `MORE_THAN_ONE`: unplug all but one; a set-network job is refused. `NOT_KNOWN`: the scan could not count - the Core cannot tell two cameras on one address apart, so connect ONE factory-address camera at a time; it is never "no conflict". It stands in the place of the boolean `conflict` of the first contract.

vendor.description: Announced. Untrusted device text: draw it as text only.

model.description: Announced. Untrusted device text: draw it as text only.

name.description: Announced. Untrusted device text: draw it as text only.

registeredDeviceId.description: The registered camera with this hardware address, if any; null otherwise.

FactoryCamera.description: One device of a commissioning scan (task 4, operation 103). It carries no credential and no link.

addressCount.description: How many addresses were asked: the stored list plus the typed one.

alias.description: The temporary host address still in place when the scan ended. The scan removes what it added before it answers, so this is null as a rule; an address is named only when its removal could not be confirmed.

synthetic.description: True for an answer of the in-app simulator: nothing was scanned and the listed device does not exist.

CameraFactoryScan.description: The result of a commissioning scan (task 4, operation 103). Not stored; a found device is registered by nothing here.

fromAddress.description: The address the camera answers at now: an address of the caller's last scan.

scannedMac.description: The hardware address the scan row of `fromAddress` showed: what the technician compared with the label on the camera. Required: a row without a hardware address cannot be started. The job is BOUND to it - it is refused when the last scan showed another, and it stops before the typed account is used when the neighbour table holds another, and before anything is set when the camera states another.

toAddress.description: The new address, inside the camera subnet. Absent: the Core takes the next free address from the configured first one.

gateway.description: The gateway to set on the camera, inside the camera subnet. Absent: none is set.

credential.description: The camera account the operator typed for this job. Write-only: never returned, stored, logged or audited; never reused for another camera or a later job.

CameraNetworkSetRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/capture/network/cameras/address` (task 4, operation 106). The prefix length comes from the configuration; DHCP mode cannot be asked.

toAddress.description: The new address: as typed, or the one the Core took; null until it is known.

scannedMac.description: The hardware address of the request: the one the technician saw on the scan row. The job changes no device that states another.

deviceCount.description: What the last scan knew of the number of devices at `fromAddress` when the job started. `NOT_KNOWN`: the count was not made, and the job ran on the hardware-address checks alone.

neighbourMac.description: The hardware address of `fromAddress` from the host's neighbour table, before anything is sent with a credential. It must equal `scannedMac`, or the job stops before the typed account is used.

authenticatedMac.description: The hardware address the camera states after authentication. It must equal `neighbourMac` and `scannedMac`, or the job stops.

confirmedMac.description: The hardware address that answered at the new address after the change. COMPLETED only when it equals `authenticatedMac`.

deviceId.description: The registered camera whose stored address this job changed with it; null when the camera is not registered.

failure.description: Why the job FAILED; null otherwise. A code: never a text the camera sent.

CameraNetworkJob.description: A set-network job (task 4, operations 106 and 107). Data of the operator session that started it; kept in memory only.

deviceId.description: The registered camera that was tested, e.g. `CAM-01`.

authenticated.description: Always true: the stored credential was read for this test. A fact, never a value.

usableProfileCount.description: Usable media profiles the test read: profiles whose stream is H.264 or HEVC, as the Core judged it. A count: no profile name and no codec text.

failedAttemptsRemaining.description: Refused credentials this host may still see before the lock-out guard closes. The guard is the one of operation 95: a typed and a stored credential count together.

reason.description: Present only for an AUTHENTICATION_FAILED test in which the credential was NOT sent (see `CaptureConnectionTestReason`).

profiles.description: What this test found about the STORED stream profiles of the camera (task 4 rows PR, V7; decision C117). `PROFILES_STORED`: the camera held none and the test stored what its stream states - the device entry of the `captureDevices` slice carries them (`profiles`) and the camera can be assigned. `STREAM_PROFILE_DIFFERS`: the camera holds stored profiles and its stream now states something else - NOTHING was stored, the stored statement stands. Absent: nothing to say (the stored and the stated agree, or the test judged no stream). A closed word: no profile code, no count.

CaptureDeviceConnectionTest.description: The outcome of one connection test of a registered camera with its stored credential (task 4, operation 108). No address, no device error text, no URL, no credential member.

id.description: Which check of the hardware acceptance package: one id of the closed list, e.g. `9A/H-17`. An id outside the list is refused.

result.description: The result of the check: `PASS`, `FAIL` or `NOT_RUN`.

detail.description: A note of the check on one line, at most 200 characters; null for none. Required, and not blank, for `FAIL` and `NOT_RUN`. It is drawn as text only.

InstallationAcceptanceStep.description: One step of an installation acceptance (task 4, schema set C; the closed list of row V6). Exactly `id`, `result`, `detail`: any other member is refused.

completedAt.description: When the run ended. An acceptance records a run that has ended.

detail.description: The English fallback text of the result. It may quote a device name: drawn as text only.

params.description: The values behind `detail`: a flat object of a closed key list.

InstallationAcceptanceDiagnostics.description: The diagnostics run of the Core as it was when the installation was accepted (task 4, schema set C). A closed key list at every level; at most 16,384 bytes as the database stores it; every text at most 200 characters on one line.

acceptedBy.description: Who accepted: the operator of the session that sent the acceptance.

softwareVersion.description: The software version of the Core at acceptance.

coreDeviceId.description: The id of the Core as it was at acceptance. A copy: a later change does not change it.

siteName.description: The name of the Core as it was at acceptance.

room.description: The room of the Core as it was at acceptance.

siteAddress.description: The address of the site as the operator typed it; null for none. It may have several lines. Drawn as text only.

id.description: A code of the first contract, e.g. `CAMERAS_ASSIGNED`. No check of the acceptance list.

passed.description: What the client of the first contract sent.

anyOf.description: A step of an installation acceptance stored before the closed step list (task 4, row V6). Answer only: a request with this form is refused.

steps.description: The steps as they were stored: the checks of the closed list with their results; a record stored before the list holds the steps of the first contract (`passed`), which name no check of the list.

revokedAt.description: When the acceptance was revoked; null while it is in force.

revokedBy.description: Who revoked it; null while it is in force.

revokeReason.description: Why it was revoked, as the operator typed it; null while it is in force. Drawn as text only.

InstallationAcceptance.description: An installation acceptance (task 4, operations 109 and 110; schema set C). In force while `revokedAt` is null; at most one is. It holds no credential.

siteAddress.description: The address of the site, 1 to 500 characters; line breaks are allowed. Absent or null: none is recorded.

steps.description: The checks of the hardware acceptance package with their results: EVERY id of the closed list (27 checks, list version 1) exactly once - an unknown, a missing or a repeated id and an empty list are refused; at most 8,192 bytes together as the database stores them.

InstallationAcceptRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/installation/acceptance` (task 4, operation 109). No member exists for who accepts, when, the version, the name or room of the Core, or the diagnostics: the Core states those itself.

reason.description: Why the acceptance is revoked: 5 to 500 characters after trimming, e.g. that the Core was moved to another room.

InstallationAcceptanceRevokeRequest.description: Request body of `POST /api/v1/installation/acceptance/revoke` (task 4, operation 110). No id: the one acceptance in force is revoked.

reason.description: Why the device is retired: REMOVED (taken out for good), REPLACED (a new unit takes its place) or STATEMENT_CHANGED (the camera now states other stream profiles). A closed set: no free text.

CaptureDeviceRetireRequest.description: The body of operation 111. Only the reason: no credential, no address, no profile.

deviceId.description: The retired device: `CAM-NN` or `MIC-NN`. Never assigned again; never reused.

kind.description: The `capture_devices.kind` value set: CAMERA, MIC, POE.

host.description: Host or address only; never a credential URL (C-N8).

online.description: On a Core in its own capture this is the registry flag of the device (`capture_devices.enabled`), NOT a reachability reading: it is true from the moment the device is registered and changes only when a pre-check, a session start or a microphone re-scan has actually asked the source (false: it did not answer; true again: it answered). Outside those moments the Core has not checked the source, so `true` means "registered and not found unreachable at the last check" - never "reachable now": a client at rest says "Not checked", not "Online" or "Ready" (finding JW-23). In Simulated mode it is the demonstration model's value.

streamState.description: Null for a device with no stream (a mic, the PoE switch). Like `online`, not a reading at rest on a Core in its own capture (finding JW-23).

capabilities.description: Capability codes the adapters reported; an open set.

adapter.description: The adapter kind behind the device (C3 §2.6 "Device shapes"): `ONVIF_RTSP`, `USB_AUDIO`, `SNMP_POE`, `FAKE` or `LOCAL_DEVICE`. Present on a device that operation 96 registered.

sourceClass.description: Derived by the Core from `adapter`: `DEVELOPMENT` exactly for `FAKE` and `LOCAL_DEVICE`. Never set by a client.

sourceOpen.description: True while the Core holds this source open (C3 §2.6, erratum PE-128-38; SEC35-44 (4)): the "is on" fact of a `LOCAL_DEVICE` - the short open of a pre-check included. A runtime fact, never stored: absent when the source is not open, after a restart until it opens, and always in simulated capture.

profiles.description: The stream profiles the Core holds stored for this camera (`capture_devices.profiles`), in the stored order, each code once. A production camera is assigned to a track with ONE of them: the `code` is sent as `profile` of a camera line of operation 78 (operation 79 carries no profile). An EMPTY list: the Core holds no profile for this camera - it cannot be assigned, and no default stands in (C36). Present on every registered camera (one that operation 96 added); absent on every other entry (a microphone, the PoE switch, a built-in device). No credential, no address, no URL, no text of the camera.

code.description: The profile code (`HEVC_1080P`, `H264_720P30`): upper-case letters, digits and underscores, 1 to 64 characters. The value a camera line of operation 78 names as `profile`.

codec.description: The codec the code states: a closed set. Null when the code is no stream statement. Never a default.

resolution.description: The picture the code states: `<height>p` for a 16:9 picture, else `<width>x<height>`. Null when the code is no stream statement. Never a default.

fps.description: The whole-number rate the code states, 1 to 240; null when it states none (an HEVC stream states no rate). Never a default.

items.description: One stored stream profile of a camera: its code and what the code states of the stream.

retiredAt.description: When the device was retired (operation 111, `capture_devices.retired_at`). PRESENT ONLY ON A RETIRED DEVICE, always together with `retiredBy`: its stored credential is destroyed, it is never assigned again, and a client lists it with a Retired state and leaves it out of every selector and assignment list. Absent: the device is in service. A retired device stays in the registry for good (its id is never reused).

retiredBy.description: The operator who retired the device (`OPR-NNN`). Present exactly when `retiredAt` is.

device.description: The device entry after the change: `retiredAt` and `retiredBy` are set. No credential member exists.

credentialDestroyed.description: True when a stored credential existed and was destroyed in the same unit (a camera with a stored password). False for a microphone, a camera without one, and always in the simulator, which stores none.

CaptureDeviceRetirement.description: The answer of operation 111: the retired device entry.

url.description: Loopback URL of the live preview stream with the cps_ token. Bearer value: never logged, never audited, never replicated.

expiresAt.description: Core instant until which the URL may be opened (60 s). A stream already open is cut when the sign-in session ends, not by this instant.

CameraPreviewSession.description: A live camera preview session (op 112; LIVE only - Simulated mode has no camera to show).

expiresAt.description: Core instant the lease ends (30 s after the call) unless it is held again.

IdleMeterLease.description: The lease of the idle microphone meters (op 113).

panelFirmware.description: The firmware version the panel reported about itself (e.g. `v3.8`), as the panel backend holds it. Empty when nothing is known: no panel, no backend, or a backend that did not answer.

verdict.description: The panel link word of the panel backend: `OK` when the panel is talking, `PANEL-DIAM`, `CORE-DIAM` or `PORT-TIDAK-ADA` when something between them is silent, and empty when the backend itself did not answer. An open set of bounded length.

PanelFirmwareResponse.description: What the attached LCD front panel states about itself: its firmware version and the panel link word. No evidence data, no session data.

satker.description: The unit word the panel shows. Empty when none was ever set.

client.description: The client word the panel shows. Empty when none was ever set.

clientLogoSaved.description: Whether a logo is stored for the client slot.

splashLogoSaved.description: Whether a logo is stored for the splash slot.

PanelSetupResponse.description: The pre-delivery setup of the LCD front panel as its backend holds it: the two identity words and whether each logo slot holds an image.

satker.description: New unit word; absent leaves the current one.

client.description: New client word; absent leaves the current one.

logoBase64.description: A PNG logo, base64-encoded, within the console path bound (the API-4 body limit); absent changes no logo.

logoTarget.description: Which slot the logo goes to; default `client`.

reason.description: Why the setup changes; free text of the audit row.

XRequestId.description: The ID of the request in the Core server's log. An error envelope repeats it as `error.requestId`.

XDemsEpoch.description: The epoch of the Core state: it counts demo resets and scenario loads. An integer, sent as decimal text (API-7).

XDemsRevision.description: The revision of the delta that holds the command's effect (the current revision when nothing replicated changed). An integer, sent as decimal text; it restarts at 0 with each epoch (API-7).

RetryAfter.description: Whole seconds until the caller's key is counted afresh.

InvalidPath.description: 400 INVALID_PATH. The path is malformed, or a path parameter is not valid percent-encoding.

NotFound.description: 404 NOT_FOUND. No operation has this path.

MethodNotAllowed.description: 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED. The path exists, but not with this method.

NotReady.description: 503 NOT_READY. The database or the engine is not ready, or a demo reset is running. Every operation except health.

OriginNotAllowed.description: 403 ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED. The `Origin` header is not on the list that fits the credential the request carries (01_specs §14.2).

CredentialConflict.description: 401 NOT_SIGNED_IN (`details.reason: CREDENTIAL_CONFLICT`). The request carries a session cookie and an `Authorization` header: one credential per request (ID-12).

RateLimited.description: 429 RATE_LIMITED. The request throttle, or the denial budget of the caller's key (20 audited refusals in 60 s), is used up.

PayloadTooLarge.description: 413 PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE. The request body is larger than 65,536 bytes.

InvalidJson.description: 400 INVALID_JSON. A body was sent that is not a JSON object. Every POST, also one that takes no body; an empty body is no body.

InternalError.description: 500 INTERNAL_ERROR or SIMULATOR_ERROR. An unexpected failure; the answer holds no detail. SIMULATOR_ERROR is the in-app simulator's code.

sessionCookie.name: dems_session_4420
sessionCookie.description: The session of a web console. `signIn` sets it as an `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict` cookie without an expiry, and its body then holds no token; the browser attaches the cookie to same-origin requests and to the socket upgrade. The name is `dems_session_<listen port>`: `dems_session_4420` on the main instance. It resolves only a session that is not bound to a device, and a POST that carries it must come from a web console origin.

bearerAuth.description: A paired device. `Authorization: Bearer` carries the device credential (prefix `dvc_`) on the device operations and at sign-in, and the session token (prefix `ses_`) once an operator is signed in on the device. The server stores only a hash of either. One credential per request: a request that carries the session cookie and this header is refused. Neither value ever travels in a URL.
